work.abstract_text: With alternative prime-residue proofs following Benyattou and Mihoubi (2017, Proposition 8) and Fried (2025, Theorem 1), we prove the four statements labelled Conjecture in Luschny and Tebni's OEIS entry A355257, revision 37, Comments, including its A355259 column-polynomial statement. For the logarithmic coefficient array A(n,k), every prime column has residue -1, and k divides A(n,k) holds exactly for nonprime k >= 1, apart from k = 4, whose residue is always 2. The quotient A(n,p)/(p-1) is integral and congruent to 1 modulo p for every even row; evenness is necessary only at p = 3,5. A factorial coefficient expansion also gives fixed-row recurrences, asymptotics, and an integer-parameter extension.

authors.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore
authors.name: Wenlin Zhang

work.title: Sharp quotients and column polynomials: alternative proofs for OEIS A355257, revision 37, Comments, after Benyattou-Mihoubi (2017) and Fried (2025)
